name: Time Travel (Remake)
author: JustYourAverageRobot
description:
A remake of one of my old games: Time travel. My game budget was 110$ and i spent a couple of days making this game. the gameplay is you going through time to defeat the boss (level 7)  there are 7 levels in total and i might add more levels.  Really hope you enjoy.  you should play until the end (level 7) because the boss battle is fun.                                                     
      NOTE: this game is the old version. the new improved one is in itch.io       
                                                                                                                            
For more Info about the full version: Email me at lileliasmac@gmail.com
